name: opentelemetry_collector_exporter_queue_nearly_full
title: OpenTelemetry Collector exporter queue nearly full
description: OpenTelemetry Collector exporter queue is over 80% full

source.upstream_alert: OpenTelemetry Collector exporter queue nearly full
source.upstream_query: (otelcol_exporter_queue_size / on(instance, job, exporter) otelcol_exporter_queue_capacity) > 0.8 and otelcol_exporter_queue_capacity > 0
source.upstream_description: OpenTelemetry Collector exporter {{ $labels.exporter }} queue is over 80% full
source.query_normalized: The upstream threshold could not be lifted out of the expression (its outermost operator is and/or/unless, or it compares against another series), so the expression is normalised to 1 per matching series and the alert fires on any match. The observed value in the notification is therefore always 1.

query_condition.promql: ((otelcol_exporter_queue_size / on(instance, job, exporter) otelcol_exporter_queue_capacity) > 0.8 and otelcol_exporter_queue_capacity > 0) * 0 + 1
